title: Stability Patterns for Spherical and Projective Braid Groups
summary: McDuff and Segal proved homological stability for unordered configuration spaces of connected manifolds with non-empty boundary. Later, Church proved representation stability for ordered configuration spaces on compact manifolds. These stability patterns extend to surface braid groups and pure surface braid groups, respectively, whenever the associated configuration space is an Eilenberg--Maclane space. However, these results do not apply to braid groups and pure braid groups on $S^2$ and $\RP^2$ since ordered and unordered configuration spaces on these surfaces are not Eilenberg--Maclane…
